plain: The inventor Nikola Tesla and the physicist Thomas Townsend Brown each discovered a little-known form of electrical physics, one that uses very high voltages across short distances, according to Michels. He says it himself, across three episodes and without naming a source. In one of them, talking with the Navy scientist Salvatore Pais, he places Tesla's version at the end of Tesla's career, at his Wardenclyffe lab and in Colorado Springs, and calls it the same thing Brown was doing. In another he says he is as sure about Brown as about anything in the UFO story, because this seems to be how the craft fly.
